name: kvmctl-pp-mcp
description: The verified REST subset used by kvmctl for KVMD-compatible GLKVM devices.

kvmctl_base_url.title: KVMCTL_BASE_URL
kvmctl_base_url.description: Optional. Sets KVMCTL_BASE_URL for the Kvmd Compatible Kvm MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.

kvmctl_kvmd_token.title: KVMCTL_KVMD_TOKEN
kvmctl_kvmd_token.description: Sets KVMCTL_KVMD_TOKEN for the Kvmd Compatible Kvm MCP server.

kvmctl_user_agent.title: KVMCTL_USER_AGENT
kvmctl_user_agent.description: Optional. Sets KVMCTL_USER_AGENT for the Kvmd Compatible Kvm MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.
